sources.name: Calgary Traffic Incidents (Archive)
sources.data_sample: Traffic incident records with location (lat/long), incident info, description, start/modified timestamps, quadrant, and WKT POINT geometry. Example: '52 Street and Mahogany Street SE, Blocking NB right lane, -113.9429748, 50.89667926'
sources.congestio_data: No direct speed/congestion data - incident type and lane impact only
sources.licence: Open Government Licence - City of Calgary v2.1
sources.usable_for: Incident locations, incident types, lane closures, historical analysis
sources.notes: Archive dataset - good for historical incident queries and spatial analysis. No real-time congestion speeds.

sources.name: Calgary Current Traffic Incidents (Real-time)
sources.data_sample: Real-time current incidents only. Same schema as archive but only current active incidents.
sources.congestion_data: No speed/volume data - incident types only
sources.licence: Open Government Licence - City of Calgary v2.1
sources.usable_for: Real-time incident monitoring, alerts, incident-based congestion assessment
sources.notes: This is the real-time feed with typically ~1 row (current incidents). Use for live incident tracking.

sources.name: Calgary Traffic Cameras
sources.data_sample: Camera locations and metadata with links to live/recent images
sources.congestion_data: Visual only (manual interpretation from images required)
sources.licence: Open Government Licence - City of Calgary v2.1
sources.usable_for: Camera locations map, visual traffic conditions at specific points
sources.notes: Cameras are on major routes and key intersections. Not automated speed/congestion extraction.

sources.name: Alberta 511 Traffic Events API
sources.data_sample: Events include: ID, SourceId, Organization, RoadwayName, DirectionOfTravel (N/S/E/W), Description, Reported (Unix), LastUpdated (Unix), StartDate, PlannedEndDate, LanesAffected, Latitude/Longitude, EventType (roadwork/closures/accidentsAndIncidents), Severity (Unknown/Minor/Major), IsFullClosure (boolean), EncodedPolyline (Google format), Restrictions (Width/Height/Weight/Speed)
fields: DirectionOfTravel (string: Unknown, All Directions, Northbound, Eastbound, Southbound, Westbound, etc.)
EventType (string: roadwork, closures, accidentsAndIncidents, specialEvents, generalInfo)
Restrictions (object: Width, Height, Length, Weight, Speed)
sources.geometry_format: Latitude/Longitude (decimal), EncodedPolyline (Google polyline), optional secondary lat/lon
sources.congestion_data: No direct speed/volume data - incident types and severity only
sources.usable_for: Real-time traffic incidents, road closures, construction, events for all of Alberta (includes Calgary and surrounding areas)
sources.notes: Covers provincial highways and key roads. Requires free registration + API key. Excellent real-time incident data but no speed/flow metrics.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API
sources.verified_http_status: 406 Not Acceptable (API requires POST with proper Content-Type)
sources.throttling: Rate limited - suggested 10 queries/min per IP
sources.data_sample: OSM road network with tags: highway type, name, lanes, maxspeed, surface, etc. Example query returns ways with highway tags in Calgary area.
sources.updated_frequency: OSM data updated by community continuously, Overpass mirrors nightly
fields: - highway (motorway, trunk, primary, secondary, residential, etc.)
sources.congestion_data: None - static road network only. No real-time speeds or volumes.
sources.licence: ODbL 1.0 (Open Data Commons Open Database License)
sources.usable_for: Road network basemap, street names, speed limits (where tagged), road hierarchy
sources.notes: Excellent for static reference data but no real-time traffic. Requires careful querying with proper bounds and filters. Community-contributed quality varies.

Check Alberta 511 data feeds for hidden speed fields (none currently documented)
